description: This file defines the 'Constant' class used to represent constants in an expression evaluator, including properties for mnemonic names and related constructor and accessor methods.

classes.name: Constant
classes.description: Represents a mathematical or logical constant used within an expression, identified by a mnemonic name.

methods.name: Constant
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the constant with a given mnemonic name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the mnemonic name of the constant.
